title: Percutaneous Left Atrial Appendage Closure (LAAC / Watchman)
description: CMS coverage for percutaneous LAAC in non-valvular atrial fibrillation patients. Requires high thromboembolic risk (CHA2DS2-VASc >= 2), formal contraindication to long-term oral anticoagulation (HAS-BLED >= 3 or prior major hemorrhage), and shared decision-making consultation.

criteria.name: High Thromboembolic Risk (CHA2DS2-VASc >= 2)
criteria.description: Documented non-valvular atrial fibrillation with high stroke risk evidenced by CHA2DS2-VASc score >= 2.

criteria.name: Contraindication to Long-Term Oral Anticoagulation
criteria.description: Documented formal contraindication or high bleeding risk (HAS-BLED >= 3, intracranial hemorrhage, recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding).
criteria.clinical_intent: Establish clinical unsuitability for warfarin/DOAC therapy
